title: Deliver approved DBSCTR slices with native Build writers

statements.text: Discovery recommends delegation and forked sessions by default from dependencies, owned paths and shared resources; serialize overlap and retain one writer per slice.

Use a separately qualified native writer for the full authorized DBSCTR cycle of one slice, through draft PR or explicitly selected delivery, while preserving independent review and ordinary helper restrictions.

Accept attributable worker test receipts for matching gates without duplicate execution. Wrong producer, checkout, tree or inputs and incomplete evidence cannot satisfy gates. Protected CI remains separate.
Use one bounded Discovery acceptance, the existing Initiative controller, native CI feedback and repair, and its tally. Draft-only multi-slice grants require agreement with the existing grant owner.
Keep qualified serial-per-target and protected integration constraints until their owner qualifies more concurrency. A fork does not clone authorization; replay cannot duplicate a writer or delivery.
Deliver via durable managed source only. Keep Linux-only CI and direct macOS use of DBSCTR without developing dotfiles-ai on macOS or interrupting active sessions.
Do not implement a parallel Auto controller, global shell permission override, unbounded GitHub mutation or a second merge path.

Prove one cycle in a fresh Herdr-launched top-level Build session in the prepared feature checkout. Collect its result by session ID and match its Cycle Record and validated head to a new draft PR into main.
